question: If I control Bilbo, Fellow Conspirator and Bard, King of Dale and I create a Food token, do I get two Food tokens and two Treasure tokens no matter which replacement effect I apply first?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you create twice as many of each kind of token, whichever order you apply the replacement effects.
expected.answer: If an effect creates more than one kind of token, it'll create twice as many of each kind. For example, if you control Bilbo, Fellow Conspirator and Bard, King of Dale and you create a Food token, you'll create two Food tokens and two Treasure tokens (regardless of the order you chose to apply the replacement effects).
